source: 635 Man-Eating Flower
target: 635 Flos Hominum Edens

source: At the entrance of the Man-Eating Flower bar, a figure strode in.
target: Ad ostium tabernae Flos Hominum Edens, figura incedit.

source: A woman, neither towering nor petite, clad in a conservative, deep-black dress, caught everyone’s attention.
target: Femina, nec excelsa nec parva, veste conservativa atque nigro profundo induta, cunctos animos captivavit.

source: Her eyebrows were meticulously drawn, her skin thickly powdered, and her cheeks adorned with noticeable blush.
target: Sobria eius dubiter delineata erant, cutis spissa pulverulata, et genae rubore conspicuo ornatae erant.

source: Her lips shone gorgeously, and the area around her eyes sparkled with gem-like hues.
target: Labia eius pulchre fulgebant, et circa oculos, quasi gemmis, micabant.

source: Despite the woman’s excessive makeup and unconventional style, her captivating brown eyes, high nose bridge, luscious lips, and curvaceous figure emitted a potent charm.
target: Quamvis femina nimis ornamenta faciei et stilum insolitum adhibebat, oculi eius brunnei, altum nasorum septum, labia succulenta, atque figura curvata potentem venustatem efferebant.

source: Male patrons in the bar shifted their gazes to the door, momentarily silent.
target: Masculi convivae in taberna oculos ad ianuam converterunt, per momentum taciti.

source: Only when the woman acknowledged a few customers with an aloof nod did the atmosphere spring to life.
target: Solum cum femina paucos clientes, capite remissius annuente, eos agnoscebat, atmosphaera in vitam rediit.

source: Some attempted conversation, while others raised their voices at their companions, trying to make an impression on her.
target: Alii colloquium inire conabantur, dum alii vocem ad comites elevabant, ut eam afficerent.

source: Without lingering, the woman navigated through the crowd and settled on the opposite side of the bar counter.
target: Sine morae, femina per turbam pergressa in altera parte mensae tabernae consedit.

source: Unique.
target: Unica.

source: If Franca were here, she’d surely strike up a conversation…
target: Si Franca hic esset, certe colloquium iniretur…

source: Lumian felt a twinge of regret for his companion and averted his gaze.
target: Lumian parvam paenitentiam pro socio sensit et aspectum avertit.

source: He smiled at the bartender and commented, “That lady seems quite popular.”
target: Subridens tabernario locutus est: “Illa domina valde nota videtur.”

source: The bartender wiped away the expression reserved for new adventurers and replied sternly,
target: Tabernarius, vultum novis adventoribus reservatum abstergens, severo respondit:

source: “She’s my boss.”
target: “Illa mea domina est.”

source: Boss… Lumian suddenly recalled the bar’s name and asked thoughtfully,
target: “Domina…” Lumian repente nomen tabernae meminit et consideratissime quaesivit:

source: “Man-Eating Flower?”
target: “Flos Hominum Edens?”

source: “It’s her,” the bartender lowered his voice and approached the beautifully made-up woman of indeterminate age.
target: “Illa est,” tabernarius vocem demittens dixit et ad pulchre ornatam feminam incertae aetatis accessit.

source: He poured her a glass of some unknown brand of Black Rand.
target: Ei poculum notae incognitae Black Rand effudit.

source: After the bartender returned, Lumian asked curiously,
target: Postquam tabernarius rediit, Lumian curiosus interrogavit:

source: “Why does she have the nickname ‘Man-Eating Flower?’”
target: “Cur sibi cognomen ‘Flos Hominum Edens’ attribuitur?”

source: “She seems very popular.”
target: “Valde nota videtur.”

source: The bartender instinctively turned his head, observing his boss as she focused on her drink and surveyed the patrons nearby.
target: Tabernarius instinctive caput vertit, dominam suam observans, dum in potionem suam incumbit et convivas prope speculabatur.

source: Leaning in, he whispered,
target: Adplicans se, susurravit:

source: “In Port Pylos, women of her caliber often relish the pursuit and adulation of men but keep them at arm’s length.”
target: “In Portu Pylos, feminae huius gradus saepe delectantur insequendo et laudes virorum, sed eos a se longe servant.”

source: “Our boss, however, is different.”
target: “Dominam nostram autem aliter habet.”

source: “If she takes a liking to you, she’ll extend an invitation for a memorable night.”
target: “Si tibi placeat, te ad noctem memorabilem invitabit.”

source: “Sometimes, we can hear her passion echoing through the halls upstairs…”
target: “Interdum audimus passionem eius per aedes superiores resonare…”

source: The bartender paused, a mix of nostalgia and desire evident on his face.
target: Tabernarius subsedit, vultum ostendens, ex mixtura memoriae et cupiditatis manifeste.

source: Pleasure?
target: Voluptas?

source: Lumian subtly frowned and inquired with a smile, “Have you ever been the object of her affections?”
target: Lumian leniter frondebat et subrisu interrogavit: “Num umquam obiectum eius affectuum fuisti?”

source: The bartender fell silent.
target: Tabernarius silentium cepit.

source: For a moment, Lumian wondered if the other would smash his head with the cup in hand.
target: Per momentum, Lumian cogitavit an alter caput suum poculo in manu tenente confringeret.

source: Changing the subject, Lumian asked, “Aren’t there brash men who try to force themselves on your boss?”
target: Mutato argumento, Lumian quaesivit: “Nonne sunt viri audaces qui conantur se in tuam dominam cogere?”

source: The bartender sighed and replied, “Remember the name of our bar.”
target: Tabernarius suspiravit et respondit: “Memento nominis tabernae nostrae.”

source: Man-Eating Flower… Is that what it means?
target: Flos Hominum Edens… Idne hoc significat?

source: Lumian grasped the meaning.
target: Lumian sensum intellexit.

source: “Those who tried to force themselves on our boss ended up badly.”
target: “Qui in nostram dominam se cogere conati sunt, male evenere.”

source: “Some were severely injured or thrown down the stairs.”
target: “Quidam grave vulnerati sunt aut de scalis coniecti.”

source: “Others simply vanished.”
target: “Alii simpliciter evanuerunt.”

source: “Even those who caught her eye would be pale the next day,
target: “Etiam qui eius oculos attraxerunt, cras pallidi erant,

source: They couldn’t walk properly.”
target: non recte ambulare poterant.

source: “That’s why she’s called ‘Man-Eating Flower.’”
target: “Quare illa ‘Flos Hominum Edens’ vocatur.”

source: “She embraces it.”
target: “Illa id amplectitur.”

source: “Eventually, she named the bar after it.”
target: “Postremo, tabernam huic nomine nominavit.”

source: This is a departure from the Demonesses of Pleasure’s style…
target: Hoc ab more Demonissarum Voluptatis differt…

source: But each demoness has her own unique approach.
target: Sed quaelibet daemonissa suam rationem singularis habet.

source: Franca, a Demoness of Pleasure, stands out from the rest…
target: Franca, daemonissa Voluptatis, inter cetera eminuit…

source: Lumian’s curiosity sated, he didn’t delve further into the bar owner.
target: Curiositate Lumiani satiata, de domina tabernae profundius non exploravit.

source: Instead, he retrieved an ordinary deck of poker cards from his Traveler’s Bag and asked, “Have you come across anyone using poker cards as a weapon recently?”
target: Pro eo, ex sacco Viatoris suo, lamina simplicem chartarum poker extraxit et interrogavit: “Num aliquem nuper invenisti qui chartas poker ut arma utebatur?”

source: According to Anthony Reid’s analysis of Hisoka, a key member of April Fool’s, Hisoka had a strong inclination towards self-expression.
target: Secundum analysim Antonii Reid de Hisoka, membro principali Aprilis Stultitiae, Hisoka vehementer ad sui ipsius exprimendum inclinabat.

source: After successfully creating the poker card with the ability to change its face, possessing Frost and Cut characteristics, it was clear he wouldn’t limit its use to mere April Fool’s pranks.
target: Postquam chartam poker, quae faciem mutare poterat et proprietates “Frost” atque “Cut” habebat, feliciter creaverat, patens erat se eius usum non solum ad ioca Aprilis intendere.

source: When engaged in combat or carrying out acts of violence, he wouldn’t hesitate to employ the mystical item to end his target’s life.
target: In certamine aut actibus violentiae implicatus, non dubitaret hoc obiectum mysticum ad finem vitae propositi sui adhibere.

source: This information presented a promising lead for investigation.
target: Haec notitia ducem sperabilem ad indagandum praebuit.

source: Regarding the two pranks orchestrated by Hisoka, they revolved around Matani and were linked to relatively confidential or significant local affairs.
target: Quoad duas iocas a Hisoka ordinatas, circa Matani versabantur atque rebus localibus, aut secretis aut gravibus, coniunctae erant.

source: Individuals who weren’t locals or lacked prolonged residence wouldn’t spontaneously choose this area unless they also possessed ample information to support their actions.
target: Qui non locales erant aut diu incolae non fuerunt, hanc regionem non sponte elegerent, nisi notitiam satis haberent ad actiones sustinendas.

source: Lumian reasonably suspected that Hisoka’s original sphere of activity centered on Matani and its neighboring regions.
target: Lumian rationabiliter suspicabat originalem ambitum actionis Hisokae in Matani et regionibus contiguis esse.

source: This rationale prompted his journey to Matani, despite believing that Hisoka had likely heeded Loki’s warning and evaded capture, concealing himself.
target: Haec ratio iter eius ad Matani impellit, etiamsi creditum est Hisokam monitionem Loki audivisse et capere evitavisse, se celans.

source: Understanding Hisoka’s past was crucial to deciphering his present and ending his future!
target: Intellectus praeteriti eius crucialis erat ad eius praesens perscrutandum atque futurum terminandum!

source: The native bartender scoffed at Lumian’s inquiry.
target: Tabernarius indigenus ad quaestionem Lumiani irridens respondit.

source: “Do you think I’d have that information?”
target: “Putasne me hanc notitiam habere?”

source: “Consult the patrol team.”
target: “Consulta turma vigiliarum.”

source: “Whether they choose to answer is another matter.”
target: “Utrum respondeant, alia res est.”

source: Patrol team… Lumian didn’t mind and nodded slightly.
target: Turma vigiliarum… Lumian non curabat et leviter annuit.

source: Established by Admiral Querarill, the ruler of Matani, the among Beyonders.
target: Ab admiralio Querarill, regente Matani, inter Beyonders institutum est.

source: In this state, following the withdrawal of most Intis colonial forces, the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Church of God of Steam and Machinery, and the new Cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother lacked official authority to enforce the law.
target: In hoc statu, post recessionem plurimarum copiarum colonialium Intis, Ecclesia Aeternae Ardoris Solis, Ecclesia Dei Vaporis et Machinarum, atque nova Cathedrale Ecclesiae Matris Terrae auctoritate officiali ad legem exsequendam caruerunt.

source: While these churches maintained Beyonder teams in their cathedrals across different cities, their jurisdiction was limited to self-defense and safeguarding believers within the cathedral.
target: Dum hae ecclesiae turmas Beyonder in suis cathedralibus per varias urbes conservabant, jurisdictio eorum ad auto-defensionem et ad fideles intra cathedralem tuendos circumscripta erat.

source: They couldn’t address matters akin to their usual spheres of influence or eliminate potential hidden dangers.
target: Negotia, quae ordinatae circumferentis potentiae erant, agere aut pericula latenta tollere non poterant.

source: Admiral Querarill entrusted the corresponding authority to the newly formed patrol team.
target: Admiralis Querarill auctoritatem novae turmae vigiliarum tradidit.

source: Some of the patrol team’s Beyonders were veterans from Admiral Querarill’s army, while others were remnants of the former Balam Empire or former adventurers and bounty hunters.
target: Nonnulli ex Beyonder turmae vigiliarum veterani erant ex exercitu Admiralis Querarill, alii reliquiae olim Imperii Balam aut olim adventorum ac praedonum.

source: What a simple name… Lumian pondered for a moment as he glanced at the few wanted posters on the wall.
target: Quale nomen simplex… Lumian per momentum meditatus est dum paucas ephemerides “wanted” in pariete intuebatur.

source: “Admiral Querarill doesn’t want adventurers turning Matani into a hunting paradise? He doesn’t want them brawling on the streets under the guise of pursuing targets on wanted posters?”
target: “Admiralis Querarill num non vult adventores Matani in paradisum venationis convertere? Num non vult eos in viis, sub excusatione metas in ephemeridibus ‘wanted’ persequi?”

source: The bartender shot Lumian a surprised look.
target: Tabernarius Lumianum, aspectu mirato, intuebatur.

source: “You’re quite sharp for an adventurer.”
target: “Es acutus admodum pro adventore.”

source: “In Matani, the wanted status is earned through crimes committed here. No one cares about your actions elsewhere.”
target: “In Matani, status ‘wanted’ per crimina hic commissa adipisci potest. Nemo alibi actus tuos attendit.”

source: As expected of one of the adventure paradises… Lumian lifted the kilju and finished it.
target: Ut exspectabatur in uno ex paradisibus adventurarum… Lumian kilju sustulit et perconsumpsit.

source: Just as he was about to switch to a glass of West Balam–specific liquor to savor its distinct flavors, he felt a gaze upon him.
target: Iam cum ad poculum liquoris West Balam, cuius sapores distinctos degustare intendebat, converteri pararetur, sensit quemquam eum intueri.

source: It was the owner of the Man-Eating Flower bar, the woman in the black dress with exquisite makeup.
target: Erat domina tabernae Flos Hominum Edens, femina in veste nigra, facie exquisita ornata.

source: Lumian nodded calmly and shifted his focus back to the bartender.
target: Lumian tranquille annuit et iterum ad tabernarium spectavit.

source: While this Man-Eating Flower was undoubtedly attractive, she couldn’t match a Demoness in terms of feminine allure.
target: Quamquam haec Flos Hominum Edens indubitanter decora erat, eam daemonissa voluptatis in venustate feminili superare non potuit.

source: Additionally, Lumian wasn’t fond of heavy makeup.
target: Praeterea, Lumian ornamenta gravia non delectabant.

source: At that moment, the woman rose from her seat and sauntered over to Lumian.
target: In illo momento, femina ex sede surrexit et ad Lumian complacide accessit.

source: She curled her lips and remarked, “I can sense that you’re like me, a living volcano, but it hasn’t erupted yet.”
target: Labris contrahentibus, dixit: “Sentio te simile mihi esse, quasi vulcanus vivus, sed nondum erupit.”

source: “You’re still enduring and waiting in pain.”
target: “Adhuc sustines et in dolore exspectas.”

source: “Tonight, are you willing to feel my passion?”
target: “Hac nocte, velisne passionem meam sentire?”

source: Lumian raised his right hand and stroked his face.
target: Lumian dextram manum levavit et faciem suam tetigit.

source: “You’re taken with me just like that?”
target: “Num statim mihi attrahiris?”

source: Come to think of it, I’ve been a hit with the ladies since my youth.
target: Memento, ex iuventute, feminis mihi favebam.

source: Being a Hunter, I’ve often found myself surrounded by all sorts of beauties…
target: Ut Venator, saepe me multarum specierum pulchritudine circumdari invenio.

source: Could this be the subtle influence of the True Men pathway?
target: Num hoc sit subtilis influxus semitae Virorum Verorum?

source: It doesn’t add up.
target: Non convenit.

source: According to The Adventurer series and recent sea rumors, Mr. Fool’s Oracle, Danitz, is also from the Hunter pathway, yet his romantic endeavors were fruitless, and he doesn’t boast any notable female companions…
target: Secundum seriem “The Adventurer” et recentia rumora maritima, Dominus Fool’s Oracle, Danitz, quoque ex semita Venatoris est, sed conatus eius amorosi frustra fuerunt et nullam notabilem comitricem feminam gloriatur.

source: Lumian muttered internally and stood up.
target: Lumian intus susurravit et surrexit.

source: He offered a smile and inquired, “How should I address you?”
target: Subridens quaesivit: “Quomodo te alloquem?”

source: “Bellotia.”
target: “Bellotia.”

source: The woman’s smile relaxed, making Lumian feel that she might appear even more stunning without her heavy makeup.
target: Risus feminae laxatus est, faciens Lumian sentire eam sine gravibus cosmetica etiam pulchriorem videri posse.

source: Lumian took off his golden straw hat, pressed it to his chest, and bowed slightly.
target: Lumian pileum aureum stramineum detraxit, ad pectus apposuit, et leviter inclinavit.

source: “Madam Bellotia, I appreciate your invitation, but there’s someone else I hold dear.”
target: “Domina Bellotia, invitationem tuam aestimo, sed aliquis alius mihi carus est.”

source: As he spoke, he disregarded Bellotia’s slightly stiffened expression and made his way past the Man-Eating Flower, heading for the bar’s entrance with composed demeanor.
target: Dum loquebatur, vultum Paululum rigidum Bellotiae neglexit et praeter Flos Hominum Edens processit, ad ostium tabernae, animi constantia, accessit.

source: Bellotia didn’t stop him.
target: Bellotia eum non retinuit.

source: Like numerous patrons in the bar, she observed as he swung open the sturdy wooden door and stepped out.
target: Ut multi convivae in taberna, illa eum observavit dum ostium lignea robusta aperiret et exire coepit.

source: As the wooden door thudded shut behind him, Lumian sneered and muttered to himself, “I can resist even the charm of a Demoness of Pleasure.”
target: Dum ostium lignea post eum ruens claudebatur, Lumian irrise submurmuravit: “Etiam daemonissae voluptatis venustati resistere possum.”

source: Why take the risk with a woman of unknown origins?
target: Cur periculum cape cum femina originis ignotae?

source: Using someone I like as an excuse is already preserving your dignity.
target: Aliquem, quem amo, uti excusatione iam dignitatem tuam servas.

source: If you still seek revenge, I won’t hold back…
target: Si adhuc ultio te movet, non retinebo…

source: Having left the bar early, Lumian wandered through the nearby streets, exploring secluded alleys in hopes of stumbling upon incidents or criminals to gather information.
target: Tabernae exitu mature, Lumian per vias prope vagatus est, angulos isolatos explorans, sperans casus aut criminosos inveniendi causa notitiam colligere.

source: After turning a few corners, he suddenly heard a clanging sound emanating from a dark and deserted alley.
target: Postquam pauca angula vertit, repente sonitum tintinnantem ex obscuro et desertico angulo audivit.

source: Silently, Lumian approached and delved into the alley.
target: Silentissime, Lumian accessit et in angulum se immergit.

source: There, he witnessed an intense battle between two men.
target: Ibi testatus est proelium acrum inter duos viros.

source: One, with evident native characteristics, appeared in his twenties.
target: Unus, cum signis indigenis manifestae, ad viginti annos natus apparuit.

source: His face was pallid, and he wielded a sharp but hefty dagger in his right hand.
target: Vultus ejus pallidus erat, et in dextra manu gladium acutum sed robustum gerebat.

source: His left palm was slightly open, and a dark shadow hovered in it, creating a chilling atmosphere.
target: Manus sinistra paulum patefacta erat, et in ea umbra atra latabat, atmosphaeram terribiliter efficiens.

source: The other, in his early thirties, had ordinary facial features and an expressionless demeanor.
target: Alter, in annis truentis initio, faciem communem et expressionem impassibilem habebat.

source: Short, black hair framed his face, and his dark-green eyes were encircled by white.
target: Breves, nigri capilli faciem eius ornabant, et oculi eius, virides obscuri, albo circumfusum erant.

source: Clad in a plain white shirt and black pants, he wielded longer, sharper weapons resembling scalpels in each hand.
target: Indutus camisia alba simplex et braccis nigris, in utraque manu arma longiora ac acutiora, quae scalpellis similia erant, gerebat.

source: At this moment, the two engaged in a fierce battle, their weapons clashing rapidly, resonating with metallic clangs.
target: Hoc tempore, duo in proelio acerbo certabant, arma celeriter inter se collidens, sonis metallicis resonantes.

source: Observing the skirmish, Lumian recognized that these weren’t ordinary individuals.
target: Spectans pugnam, Lumian perspexit hos non esse homines ordinarios.

source: They both bore Beyonder characteristics.
target: Ambo notas Beyonder habebant.

source: Halting his advance, Lumian nonchalantly stood with his hands in his pockets, his right foot propped up against the wall.
target: Sistens, Lumian manibus in sinu positis, dextro pede ad murum innixo, non sollicitus stetit.

source: He unabashedly observed the close-quarters combat between these Beyonders.
target: Absque ullo verecundo, certamen propinquo inter hos Beyonder observavit.
